title: Yaade Abbas me zainab ne pukaara Abbas
body:
YAADE ABBAS MEIN ZAINAB NE PUKAARA ABBAS
DASHT MEIN CHHOD GAYE KYON MUJHE TANHA ABBAS
QHALB ZAKHMI HAI MERA KAISE SANBHALOON QUD KO, MERI AANKHAON MEIN HAI AKBAR KA KALEJA ABBAS
TERE MARNE NE KAMAR TOODI MERA BHAYI KI, DEGA MAAJAYE KO AB KOUN SAHARA ABAAS
<<DIVIDER>>
SUNTI HU HAATH KATE SAR PA LAGA GURZ TERE, KAISE TUHJ PAR YE SITAM HOGAYE BHAIYYA ABBAS
AB NA QASIM HAI NA AKBER HAI NA BHAYI SHABBIR, BEKASAON KA NAHI AB KOI SAHARA ABBAS
TERE DAM SE THI HAR EK BIBI KE DIL KO DHARAS, AB HAR EK LAB PA HAI BAS TERA HI NOUHA ABBAS
AAG KHAIMAON MEIN LAGI BISTARE BIMAAR JALA, JALGAYA ASGHAR-E-BESHEER KA JHOOLA ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
KAAN BHI ZAKHMI HAIN RUQHSAAR BHI ZAKHMI USKE, KAISE DOON TERI SAKINA KO DILASA ABBAS
KAMSINI MEIN HAIN SAKINA PE MAZALIM PAIHAM, USKA AB KOI NAHIN POOCHNE WALA ABBAS
SAR PA CHADAR NAHIN BAZOO MEIN RASAN HAI MERE, DEKHTE KYON NAHIN AAKAR MERE BHAIYYA ABBAS
MUSHKILEN DUR HUI MUJHSE USI LAMHA RASHEED, MAINE JAB TOOTE HUE DIL SE PUKARA ABBAS..
